_comment: The cratered country, and the craters themselves. Said of the land, or alone, it is the landform it always was;
said of the features (`cratered features`) it is the old craters (`craters`); said of the Age (`cratered age`)
it is the landform, and half the time the craters over it too (Jonah). Authored over the landform's derived word
to say the second and third; the first is that word's, unchanged.
